title: Reproduction materials: Tabular foundation models are not a shortcut to calibrated clinical risk prediction

creators.name: Ebrahim, Ebrahim Khaled
creators.affiliation: Department of Applied Statistics, Faculty of Business, Alexandria University, Alexandria, Egypt

description:
Code for the article "Tabular foundation models are not a shortcut to calibrated clinical risk prediction: a pre-registered simulation against the true risk" by Ebrahim Khaled Ebrahim. The study was pre-registered on OSF Registries (doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/8HMTZ) before the main run.

The archive holds (1) the simulation engine: the 58 scenarios of the core and stress designs and the 1,000-design random tier, the model arms (logistic regression, Firth logistic regression with intercept correction, ridge, GAM, LightGBM with Platt scaling, TabPFN-3.5, TabICLv2 and Mitra-v2), the recalibration ladder and the true-risk estimands; (2) the goodness-of-fit layer in R, which runs the external-validation battery of ebrahim.gof 2.10.0 on the frozen predictions, with the package source at the commit used; (3) the real-data loaders and runner for the International Stroke Trial, CRASH-2, the Sepsis Survival Minimal Clinical Records and the PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2012; (4) the scripts that produce every table and figure of the article and its supplement; (5) the registered protocol and the log of deviations from it; (6) the recorded software environment.

No real data and no model weights are included. The real data are available from their providers under their own terms; the archive holds the loaders, a download script for the two open data sets and the SHA-256 of every file used. TabPFN-3.5 weights may not be redistributed; a script downloads them after the user has accepted the licence and checks their checksums.

The per-replicate predictions and test results are a separate record (the benchmark record). Code is under the MIT licence; the protocol and documents are under CC BY 4.0. See README.md for how to reproduce each result.
notes: Code: MIT licence. Pre-registration and documents: CC BY 4.0. The bundled ebrahim.gof source keeps its GPL-3 licence. No data from the International Stroke Trial, CRASH-2, the Sepsis Survival Minimal Clinical Records or the PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2012, and no model weights, are included.
